# Pack: node-health

Compute-node health from a JSON list of per-node reports that a site's own health exporter writes to node-health/records.json (each report has node, cluster, observed_at and checks, a list of name, status ok or warn or fail, and detail).

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | `context` |
| Version | `0.1.0` |
| Needs a credential to publish | no |
| Okg modules it needs | `document_starter`, `person`, `extraction` |
| Packs it needs | none |

## In which bundles

- Default in: none
- Optional in: [`cluster-manager`](../bundles/cluster-manager.md)

Add it to an instance with `archi add node-health`.

## Sources

- `node-health.node_health`

## Questions

`archi init` asks these. Answer one with `--answer node_health_<id>=VALUE`.

| Id | Type | Required | Default | Prompt |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cluster_name` | `string` | no | `cluster` | Cluster name |
